claims: The 82nd Airborne Division is based at Fort Liberty, NC.
Fort Liberty was formerly Fort Bragg.
Fort Liberty is in North Carolina.
The 82nd Airborne was deployed to the Middle East in 2026 to secure positions.
Paratroopers utilize High Altitude Low Opening (HALO) and High Altitude High Opening (HAHO) for stealth insertion, say YouTube videos.
All candidates must be volunteers to become a paratrooper.
Paratroopers must exhibit high intelligence and self-discipline to handle complex operations, say Wikipedia and Youtube videos.
Training to become a paratrooper culminates in qualifying jumps to earn airborne wings.
Airborne Soldiers is a broader term for troops who arrive by air, which includes paratroopers (parachute) and air assault troops (helicopters).
Paratroopers often carry 100 to 150 lbs of gear, including a main parachute, reserve parachute, rifle, and rucksack, notes this YouTube video.
Paratrooper jumps generally occur from 100 to 400 meters.
Paratrooper jumps typically use static-line, round-canopy parachutes.
The British "Red Devils" are paratrooper forces.
Paratroopers are paid based on standard military ranks, supplemented by jump pay.
Jump pay is standard for airborne-qualified personnel.
